thread:
marta-g: Quick kickoff for a compact cloud+SI onramp with Polaris Systems (SI) + RackForge (hw). Goal: publishable Terraform module, marketplace quick-deploy, short ops runbook, and 1-paragraph partner blurb. Meeting Wed 10am PT. Owners?

benji: I can take the Terraform module. Plan: small API, defaults for cloud, a `bare_metal_profile` mapping for RackForge. Will add outputs for telemetry and a `deploy_toggle` flag for staged rollout.

sophia: I'll do the marketplace template and the short FAQ. Recommend a lightweight IAM role example for marketplace integration.

danielops: Ops will produce the runbook and smoke tests. Need to know what telemetry hooks (Datadog/Prometheus) to expose. Also will add a canary label to enable per-customer toggles.

marta-g: Notes: embargo until legal clears. Proposed timeline: module PR in 5 days, quick-deploy page in Console 2 days after PR merge, early access cohort for 10 customers, public listing + blog 3 weeks after early access start.

benji: Draft TF snippet (WIP):
```hcl
module "polaris_onramp" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refkits/marketplace//polaris?ref=v0.0.1"
  region = var.region
  profile = var.bare_metal_profile
  enable_telemetry = true
}
```
I'll include `telemetry_endpoint` and `canary_tag` outputs.

sophia: For the FAQ: include supported regions, bare-metal preprovisioning steps, and HSM note (handled by partner). Ill ask partner PM for logos and approved quote.

partner-bot: Created ticket ONRAMP-456 assigned to benji, due in 7d.

marta-g: Action list: benji TF + tests, sophia marketplace + FAQ, danielops runbook + smoke tests, marta coordinate legal + partner assets. Reply with short repo name suggestions (<=16 chars).
